techniques.label: parallel-b-standard-45-techniques
techniques.observations: All216 production-color frames actually inspected in six native paired sheets: nine equipped techniques, front/side, twelve times each. Earth strike/pulse/breaker, lightning pulse, expose, rally, protect, purify and signature keep the face, lower cheeks/chin, neck/scarf, shell and legs together. Opposite-side companion lighting resolves dark raw chin shadow and shows a continuous tan profile through motion and recovery.

limits: Local exact-hash review, no live delivery or authenticated modal claim. Scarf naturally covers some throat surfaces and shell occludes inner limb joints; exposed chin, neck boundary and legs inspected in brighter production views. One fresh216-frame battle companion technique capture, not source override or an independent second timing capture. Original component provenance retained exactly.
